instruction: A clean, minimalist lifestyle photograph captured from a low angle wide shot. Inside a bright, white-walled yoga studio with large windows, two subjects perform a deep stretch. In the foreground right, the young woman in the beige sports bra (R4) is bent forward over her front leg in a deep pigeon pose, her head lowered and hands flat on the floor. Behind her to the left, the blonde girl in the beige long-sleeve top (R5) mirrors this deep forward bend, her head lowered towards the ground. They are aligned diagonally in unison. Bright, soft natural light fills the space, creating a serene, neutral-toned atmosphere.

R5 is positioned behind R4 and mirrors R4's deep forward bend
